post.text: BREAKING - X’s head of product, Nikita Bier, has announced that nearly half a million dollars has been deducted from fake posters who were demonetized for sharing fake and fraudulent war footage in this week’s creator payout, and the money will be redistributed to X creators. https://t.co/1sCm8xSIaP
post.author_description: The Right Angle of The Story | Breaking news? DM me to report it | Independent news reporter

description.description: A split-screen video frame. On the left side, there is a static social media post by Nikita Bier on X.com explaining that an additional $335,000 has been allocated to creator payouts, funded by suspending users who post undisclosed AI-generated war videos and deducting earnings from posts with false information Community Notes. On the right side, a video depicts what appears to be a bird's-eye view of a city at night with a large, glowing orange explosion or light source in the sky, which then shifts in the second frame to a blurry, dark, and shaky close-up perspective.
description.ocrText: Nikita Bier  @nikitabier X.com Happy Friday—In this week's creator payout, we have allocated an additional $335,000 to X's creators. This was funded by: 1. Users who were suspended from the program for posting AI-generated war videos without disclosure 2. Deducting earnings from posts that received a Community Note for posting false information Remember to thank these folks for their generous donation.
